notes: Fix. A pasted “Click Me” link no longer flattens the cell: a sheet formats a pasted cell from the HTML it was given, so a link that claimed no alignment landed left and on the bottom of a row that was centred and middled. The paste now says where the text sits - Center by default, Left or Right or “as it comes” in Settings - and always vertical middle. The plain URL flavour, and everything with the switch off, is unchanged.
